protocol: Matched OpenWebText validation where available; 128 GPT-2 BPE tokens per optimizer update
claim: Energy, global Lyapunov exponent, and state rank are insufficient predictors of NLL. The next hypothesis is that NLL follows future-predictive input-output alignment and its signal-to-interference ratio under a bounded open-system evolution.
theory_falsification_gate: Before a new architecture run, matched real-OWT prefix/suffix experiments and low-rank controllability-observability estimates must explain the established model ordering and v1/v3 role reversal better than energy, rank, or global conditional lambda.
next_architecture_if_gate_passes: One low-rank orthogonal three-port boundary scatterer with independent token-write and bath-outflow couplings, conservative internal collision and transport, and no gamma, hard clip, resource, fatigue, spillover, separate outflow, or inference-time integral controller.
